request.style: English, Celtic advent carol, pure gentle female vocal, Celtic harp, tin whistle, fiddle, soft bodhran, drone, luminous and hushed, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the sixth month in Nazareth, a town of Galilee
God sent the angel Gabriel to a girl of low degree
Promised to a man named Joseph, from the house of David's line
And the virgin's name was Mary, and the hour was God's design

[Verse]
Greetings, you who are favored! The Lord is with you
She was deeply troubled and she wondered at his word
Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God
You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to name him Jesus

[Chorus]
I am the Lord's servant
May it be to me according to your word
I am the Lord's servant
May it be to me according to your word

[Verse]
He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High
He will reign over the house of Jacob forever
His kingdom will never end
How will this be, she asked him, how can it come to be
The Holy Spirit will come upon you, said the angel tenderly

[Chorus]
I am the Lord's servant
May it be to me according to your word
I am the Lord's servant
May it be to me according to your word

[Bridge]
And consider your relative Elizabeth
In her old age with a son
For nothing will be impossible with God

[Outro]
May it be to me according to your word
And the angel left her
